import json, sys, numpy as np
from fractions import Fraction as F
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
p=json.load(sys.stdin)
checks=[]
for case in p['hierarchy']:
    x=np.array(case['tree']['points'])
    own=case['tree']['merges']
    reference=linkage(x,method=case['linkage'])
    np.testing.assert_allclose([r['height'] for r in own], reference[:,2], rtol=1e-12,atol=1e-12)
    checks.append({'kind':'changed five-point hierarchy versus SciPy','linkage':case['linkage'],'heights':reference[:,2].tolist()})
for case in p['weighted']:
    x,w,l=case['points'],case['weights'],case['labels']
    total=F(0)
    for group in range(3):
        members=[i for i,v in enumerate(l) if v==group]
        if not members:
            assert case['result']['centers'][group]==case['previous'][group]
            continue
        mass=sum(w[i] for i in members)
        expected=[sum(F(x[i][j])*w[i] for i in members)/mass for j in range(2)]
        np.testing.assert_allclose(case['result']['centers'][group],[float(v) for v in expected],rtol=1e-13,atol=1e-13)
        # Independently use weighted pair differences, not residual-to-mean sums.
        for at,i in enumerate(members):
            for j in members[at+1:]:
                total += F(w[i]*w[j],mass)*sum((F(x[i][a])-F(x[j][a]))**2 for a in range(2))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(case['result']['sse'],float(total),rtol=1e-13,atol=1e-13)
    checks.append({'kind':'changed exact nonuniform-weight means/SSE and empty retention','SSE':str(total)})
with threadpool_limits(limits=1):
    for case in p['palettes']:
        s=case['state']; x=np.array(s['colors'],dtype=float); counts=np.array(s['counts'])
        fit=KMeans(n_clusters=case['k'],init=x[s['initialIndices']],n_init=1,tol=0,algorithm='lloyd',random_state=0).fit(x,sample_weight=counts)
        # Match centers, rather than pretending integer cluster IDs are identities.
        costs=((np.array(s['centers'])[:,None]-fit.cluster_centers_[None])**2).sum(axis=2)
        rows,columns=linear_sum_assignment(costs)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(costs[rows,columns],0,rtol=0,atol=1e-20)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(s['sse'],fit.inertia_,rtol=1e-12,atol=1e-10)
        actual=sum(sum((a-b)**2 for a,b in zip(original,reconstructed)) for original,reconstructed in zip(p['pixels'],s['reconstructed']))
        assert actual==s['displayedSse']
        checks.append({'kind':'actual UI palette versus separately fitted weighted sklearn centers','k':case['k'],'SSE':fit.inertia_,'displayedIntegerSSE':actual})
assert p['initialSix'][1]['sse']==19.25
assert p['initialSix'][2]['sse']==7.6875
checks.append({'kind':'six-point assignment/movement bridge','before':19.25,'after':7.6875})
assert sum((F(v)-2)**2 for v in [1,2,9])==50
assert sum((F(v)-4)**2 for v in [1,2,9])==38
assert F(2*2,4)*(7-1)**2==36
checks.append({'kind':'mean and linkage inline figure exact arithmetic','meanSSE':[50,38],'wardDelta':36})
json.dump({'passed':True,'checks':checks,'count':len(checks)},sys.stdout)
